figurative_meaning_en: Quarrels and fights among family members
example_sentences_in_bangla: তাদের গৃহবিবাদের কারণে সংসারে শান্তি নেই।
গৃহবিবাদ এড়িয়ে চললে জীবন সুখী হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: Their domestic quarrels have disrupted the family peace.
Avoiding family feuds leads to a happier life.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali emphasis on family harmony.
